snippet.title: Atelier Ryza Secret Trilogy Deluxe Pack - First Trailer
snippet.description:
Visit the website: https://atelier.games/secretdx/us/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=FirstTrailerUS&utm_id=Caption

An unseen summer awaits.

Atelier Ryza Secret Trilogy Deluxe Pack is coming to PlayStation®5, PlayStation®4, Nintendo Switch™ 2, Nintendo Switch™ and Steam® on November 13th, 2025.

This title is a definitive collection featuring all three titles from the “Secret” series. This Deluxe Pack will include exclusive content such as new playable characters and new story elements for each of the three titles.
